name: Frank B. Allen
role: Secretary and attorney of the N. P. Refrigerator Car Co., of Bismarck
bio: Frank B. Allen, of Bismarck, was an officer of the Marquis de Mores's Northern Pacific Refrigerator Car Co.; the paper calls him both its secretary and its attorney. In April 1884 he travelled to Deadwood to arrange a railroad project and returned with E. Deffebach, after which guide-boards were painted to mark the Medora-Black Hills route. He witnessed certificates signed by Erasmus Deffebach in the fall of 1884 and is listed as a vice-president of an organization that December. The Cow Boy also recorded Medora's jokes at his expense, fitting him for chaps and mocking his plug hat.
